The loop, explained

Four stages. No middlemen. No missing payments.

Every job in TradeLoop moves through the same trusted sequence — so both sides always know exactly where things stand.

01

Post the job

Describe what needs doing, snap a photo of the space, and set your budget in rand. Takes under two minutes.

STATUS: OPEN
02

Get claimed

Verified workers nearby see it land in their feed instantly and claim the ones that match their skills.

STATUS: CLAIMED
03

Verify with photos

Job's done? Three photos go up. You confirm in the app — no arguing over whether the work actually happened.

STATUS: VERIFIED
04

Get paid instantly

Funds release straight to the worker's TradeLoop wallet the moment it's confirmed. Cash out same day.

STATUS: PAID

Trust & safety

Built so nobody gets burned.

Informal work has always run on trust. TradeLoop just gives that trust a paper trail.

Photo-verified payouts

No job gets marked paid without three timestamped photos confirming the work. It's proof both sides can point to.

A wallet, not cash-in-hand

Earnings land in a worker's TradeLoop wallet automatically and can be withdrawn any day — no more chasing people down for what's owed.

ID & skill verification

Every worker on the loop verifies their ID and a selfie match before they can claim their first job. You know who's coming to your door.

Ratings that mean something

Both sides rate each other after every job. A worker's score is built from real, completed work — not reviews bought or borrowed.
